description: Cross-system reconciliation and consistency workflow for device swap orders across TAAS, Camara, inventory, billing, and provisioning systems.

swap_order_id.description: Primary identifier of a device swap order in the orchestration system.

external_order_ref.description: Reference and correlation identifiers in external systems.

id.description: Order or transaction identifier in the external system.

correlation_id.description: Correlation or request id used in async APIs.

sku.description: Stock keeping unit or product code.

party_context.description: Information identifying the customer, subscription, and account.

msisdn.description: Phone number associated with the subscription.

system_state_snapshot.description: Snapshot of state across systems for a given swap order.

reconciliation_issue.description: Detected inconsistency between systems for a swap.

parameters.description: Free-form parameters specific to the compensation action.

blocking.description: If true, must succeed before proceeding to next actions.

audit_event_id.description: Identifier of an audit log entry.

subscription_id.description: Identifier of a webhook or notification subscription.

snapshot_id.description: Identifier of a captured state snapshot.

functions.name: create_reconciliation_batch
functions.description: Create a new reconciliation batch for device swap orders across TAAS and Camara systems.

scope.description: Definition of which swap orders to include in the batch.

status_filter.description: Subset of orchestration-level statuses to reconcile.

max_orders.description: Maximum number of swap orders to include.

initiated_by.description: User or system initiating the reconciliation batch.

auto_compensation.description: Whether to automatically apply safe compensation actions.

issue_severity_threshold.description: Minimum severity of issues to consider for compensation.

functions.returns: Reconciliation batch identifier and initial batch metadata.

functions.name: list_reconciliation_batches
functions.description: List reconciliation batches with filters and pagination.
functions.returns: Paginated list of reconciliation batches with optional aggregate statistics.

functions.name: discover_inconsistent_swap_orders
functions.description: Discover swap orders with potential inconsistencies across TAAS, Camara, and related systems, and attach them to an existing reconciliation batch.

heuristics.description: Heuristics to detect suspect swap orders.

status_inconsistency.description: Include orders where system statuses disagree.

missing_in_any_system.description: Include orders missing from at least one system.

age_threshold_minutes.description: Minimum age of IN_PROGRESS orders to treat as suspect.

billing_not_applied.description: Include orders where device swap completed but billing not adjusted.

limit.description: Upper limit of newly discovered swap orders to add to batch.

functions.returns: Summary of discovered swap orders and count added to the batch.

functions.name: capture_system_state_snapshot
functions.description: Capture a detailed system state snapshot for a specific swap order across TAAS, Camara, inventory, and billing systems.

external_refs.description: Known external references that can improve matching.

include_raw_payloads.description: If true, includes raw API payloads for diagnostics.

systems.description: Subset of systems to include, defaults to all.

functions.returns: A system_state_snapshot object containing per-system state and metadata.

functions.name: analyze_swap_inconsistencies
functions.description: Analyze a captured system state snapshot to detect and classify reconciliation issues.

expected_target_state.description: Optional explicit target state for the swap order.

functions.returns: List of reconciliation_issue objects, each with severity, affected systems, and suggested actions.

functions.name: plan_compensation_actions
functions.description: Generate a compensation plan (rollback or forward-fix) to resolve detected inconsistencies for a swap order.

constraints.description: Constraints on what compensation is allowed.

functions.returns: Ordered list of proposed compensation_action objects with rationale and dependencies.

functions.name: execute_compensation_plan
functions.description: Execute a previously generated compensation plan for a swap order with transactional controls.

plan_id.description: Identifier of the stored compensation plan.

action_overrides.description: Optional modifications to the plan before execution.

action_index.description: Index of the action in the original plan.

rollback_on_failure.description: If true, attempt to undo successfully executed actions if a later action fails.

functions.returns: Execution report detailing per-action status, any rollbacks performed, and final consistency status.

functions.name: retry_failed_swap_operations
functions.description: Retry failed or timed-out operations for a swap order across TAAS and Camara with configurable backoff.

operation_scope.description: Limit retries to specific operation types.

only_if_idempotent.description: Avoid retrying operations known to be non-idempotent.

functions.returns: Summary of retried operations, outcomes, and updated swap order status where applicable.

functions.name: rollback_device_swap
functions.description: Perform a high-level rollback of a device swap order, including TAAS, Camara, inventory, and billing adjustments.

force_rollback.description: Attempt rollback even if some systems report unknown state.

functions.returns: Rollback transaction report including per-system results and final order lifecycle status.

functions.name: get_swap_reconciliation_status
functions.description: Get reconciliation and consistency status for a specific swap order, including outstanding issues.
functions.returns: Composite view of swap order reconciliation state, including detected issues and applied/queued actions.

functions.name: reconcile_batch_summary
functions.description: Compute and retrieve summary reconciliation metrics for a given batch of swap orders.
functions.returns: Batch-level reconciliation metrics and optional group-by breakdowns.

functions.name: mark_issue_for_manual_review
functions.description: Escalate a specific reconciliation issue for manual review and optionally block automatic actions.

issue_id.description: Identifier of the reconciliation issue within the order.

attachments.description: Optional external references like ticket ids or documents.

functions.returns: Manual review record identifier and updated issue status.

functions.name: synchronize_missing_swap_in_system
functions.description: Create or align a missing device swap record in one target system based on the orchestration canonical view.

canonical_view.description: Canonical representation of the swap, if already computed; otherwise it will be fetched.

functions.returns: Result of synchronization, including created/updated external_order_ref and any validation conflicts.

functions.name: search_swap_orders
functions.description: Faceted search across swap_order records with rich filters, full-text query, and faceted aggregations for device_swap_reconciliation_flow.

filters.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

highlight.description: Return highlighted snippets when matching text

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated result set of swap_order records with facet buckets, total count, and continuation cursor.

functions.name: list_swap_orders_by_status
functions.description: List swap_order records filtered by lifecycle status with stable cursor pagination.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A paginated list of swap_order records matching the requested statuses, optionally with summary metrics.

functions.name: get_swap_order_detail
functions.description: Fetch a single swap_order record with optional expansion of related entities and versioned snapshots.

as_of.description: Read the record as of this point in time

version_id.description: Specific version to retrieve when versioning is enabled

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A swap_order record with the requested expansions and version metadata.

functions.name: bulk_create_swap_orders
functions.description: Submit a batch of swap_order records for creation, with idempotency keys and partial-success reporting.

tags.description: Tags applied to the new record

trace_id.description: Correlation id propagated across the batch

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A per-item outcome list with created identifiers, validation errors, and batch-level statistics.

functions.name: bulk_update_swap_orders
functions.description: Apply partial updates to many swap_order records in a single transactional batch.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

patch.description: JSON merge-patch applied to every matched record

dry_run.description: Compute affected count without applying changes

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Affected record count, sampled previews, and any per-record errors.

functions.name: bulk_archive_swap_orders
functions.description: Soft-archive swap_order records matching a selector with optional grace period before purge.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

preserve_audit.description: Keep audit trail even after purge

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Archive operation summary including matched count, scheduled purge date, and any blockers.

functions.name: export_swap_orders
functions.description: Asynchronously export a filtered slice of swap_order records to the configured object store.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

destination.description: Where the export should be delivered

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An export job descriptor with status, destination URI, and progress callbacks.

functions.name: subscribe_swap_order_events
functions.description: Register a webhook subscription for swap_order lifecycle events with HMAC signing and replay protection.

filter.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

signing_secret_ref.description: Reference to the HMAC signing secret

tls_verify.description: Whether to validate the server certificate

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A subscription handle including subscription_id, verification status, and current delivery health.

functions.name: unsubscribe_swap_order_events
functions.description: Disable or delete a previously created swap_order event subscription.

drain_seconds.description: Grace period to flush in-flight events

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Final subscription state and any undelivered event counts at the time of termination.

functions.name: get_swap_order_audit_history
functions.description: Retrieve the chronological audit log for a swap_order including who changed what and when.

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: An ordered list of audit entries with diffs, actor metadata, and correlation ids.

functions.name: query_swap_order_changelog
functions.description: Query the cross-record changelog for device_swap_reconciliation_flow with field-level filters.

selector.description: Boolean filter tree with nested AND/OR support

value.description: Comparison value, type depends on op

fields_changed.description: Restrict to changes touching these fields

cursor.description: Opaque continuation token for stable pagination

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Aggregated changelog rows or detail entries depending on group_by, plus totals.

functions.name: schedule_swap_order_job
functions.description: Create a recurring or one-off scheduled job that runs a device_swap_reconciliation_flow operation.

operation.description: Operation name to invoke when the schedule fires

input_template.description: Parameters passed to the operation, with templating

failure_policy.description: What to do when a run fails

max_failures.description: Pause schedule after this many failures

alert_channel.description: Channel id to alert on failure

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A schedule descriptor including schedule_id, next run time, and validation issues.

functions.description: Temporarily pause a scheduled device_swap_reconciliation_flow job without deleting its history.

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.name: simulate_swap_order_execution
functions.description: Run a dry-run simulation of a device_swap_reconciliation_flow execution path without producing side effects.

include_side_effect_plan.description: Return the side effects that would have been emitted

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Simulation transcript with predicted outcome, side-effect plan, and assertions checked.

functions.description: Compute a preview of how a proposed change would affect a swap_order prior to commit.

evaluate_policies.description: Run policy engine against the proposed state

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: A preview document with field diffs, policy verdicts, and dependency impact.

functions.description: Submit a swap_order for review with configurable approver routing and SLA targets.

approver_group.description: Group or role authorised at this step

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Approval workflow handle with approval_id, current step, and projected completion time.

functions.description: Record an approve/reject/recuse decision for a pending swap_order approval step.

conditions.description: Conditions attached to a conditional approval

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.description: Escalate a stuck or breached swap_order to a higher tier with paging and audit.

context_refs.description: Related artifact ids attached for context

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

query.description: Query spec, polymorphic by panel type

enforcement_mode.description: How strictly the policy is applied

actor.description: Caller identity used for audit and authorization

functions.returns: Policy version descriptor with policy_id, version_id, and validation report.

functions.description: Evaluate the active device_swap_reconciliation_flow policies against a candidate input and return verdicts.
